title: Idle Breaker
tagline: An automated tool for liquidity providers on Uniswap V4 that detects out-of-range positions and optimizes idle assets by redeploying them into lending protocols, reducing management complexity and maximizing yield.
description: Liquidity providers on Uniswap often face challenges with idle assets when their positions fall out of range, leading to lost yield opportunities. This tool addresses the problem by monitoring liquidity positions, detecting when assets fall out of range, and automating the process of redeploying them into yield-generating lending protocols. By integrating risk assessment, yield optimization, and liquidity monitoring, the tool empowers users to maximize returns on their assets while minimizing management complexity.
how_its_made:
1. Leverage Uniswap V4 Hooks: Uniswap V4 introduces add/remove liquidity hooks, enabling real-time detection of pool price changes. This allows us to dynamically adjust user positions, maximizing their benefits and optimizing returns.

2. Seamless Integration with UniChain: The solution leverages both Uniswap V3 and Uniswap V4 features, making integration straightforward within the UniChain Sepolia ecosystem, ensuring compatibility and ease of use.

3. Utilizing Blockscout's ERC-721 API: With Uniswap V3, user positions are represented as NFTs. By using Blockscout's robust ERC-721 API, we can efficiently fetch and manage user NFT data, simplifying the process and enhancing performance.
